From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@novapath.io>

Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@novapath.io>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot window — brief extension request while PO routes

Hi Camila,

Quick note from procurement side at Novapath — our finance team pulled the PO to include one additional legal clause and routing will add ~7–10 business days. The pilot is currently scheduled to expire next Wednesday and our engineers still need a few more end-to-end runs to finish the evaluation.

Is there a way to keep our sandbox live (or get a short voucher) while the PO moves through finance? We don’t want to lose the progress or have to restart warm caches. If you need a PO stub I can send the internal PR reference.

Thanks,
Morgan

--
Morgan Lee
Head of Platform Integrations | Novapath
morgan.lee@novapath.io
From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@novapath.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot window — brief extension request while PO routes

Hi Morgan — thanks for the heads up and for flagging the PR reference. We can absolutely help keep the pilot live while procurement finishes. Two quick questions:

- How many active seats / CI runs do you expect to run over the next two weeks?
- What’s your best estimate for PO submission date?

Proposal from our side (pending internal approval):
- Provision a temporary 50,000-token credit to your sandbox, valid for 14 days from the time we activate it.
- Keep the pilot endpoint and KV caches intact so you don’t need to re-warm.

I’m looping in Laura (CS) and David (Finance lead) to confirm we can safely apply the credit and record it against DEAL-7821. Morgan — if you can share the PO_stub (or PR reference) I’ll attach it to the ticket for our billing team.

Attaching the simple PO stub template we usually accept (PO_stub_novapath.xlsx) — feel free to populate the PR id and upload when ready.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll follow up after internal sign-off and provide exact activation window. Appreciate the heads-up — don’t want you to lose momentum.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot window — brief extension request while PO routes

Camila / Laura — reviewed. Approved to provision a short-term credit for Novapath against DEAL-7821 with these constraints:

- 50,000-token credit
- Valid for 14 calendar days from activation timestamp
- One-time grant; will be reconciled once PO is received and invoiced against the agreed contract terms
- Mark billing note: "pilot-supplement — PO pending: PR-45821"

Please add a short internal approval note to the CRM and attach approval-note.pdf for auditing. Finance will not auto-bill during the voucher window; once the PO arrives we’ll offset the credit on the first invoice.

David
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai
From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@novapath.io>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@novapath.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-09T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot window — brief extension request while PO routes

Morgan / Sarah — quick update: Finance approved a one-time provisional credit as discussed. We’ve scheduled activation to preserve your pilot run. Details below:

- Credit: 50,000 tokens (one-time)
- Activation: I will activate now — token balance will appear in your sandbox immediately
- Expiry: 2027-08-23T14:22:00-07:00 (14 days from activation)
- Notes: Coded as "pilot-supplement — PO pending: PR-45821" in our billing record

Next steps for Novapath:
- Please submit the finalized PO (attach to this thread or upload to the portal) as soon as it’s available.
- If the final PO modifies quantity/pricing materially, we’ll reconcile on the first invoice as David mentioned.

I’ve also attached a short text file with the credit details and link to the live dashboard so your engineering lead can monitor token burn (trial-credits-details.txt). If you’d like more runway we can discuss a short paid add-on, but for now this should keep your tests running.

Thanks — glad we could keep the pilot moving.

Warmly,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
